question: The Fifth Khelo India Youth Games 2022 was organised in ______ in 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Youth Games:-**

 
 
• It is an initiative by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, Government of India, to promote sports and identify young talent in the country.
 
• The** first edition** of the Khelo India Youth Games was held in **2018,** and since then, it has become an annual event.
 
• The Fifth Khelo India Youth Games were held in Madhya Pradesh in 2022.
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games includes various sports such as **athletics, boxing, swimming, weightlifting**, and many more.
 
• The Games provide a platform for young athletes to showcase their talent and also receive** financial support** from the government to pursue their sporting careers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Assam** hosted the** third edition** of the Khelo India Youth Games in **2020.**
 
• **Maharashtra** hosted the **second edition** of the Khelo India Youth Games in **2019.**
